say:2:1410546001:1.text: This is unbelievable. I can't believe that I've been living a lie my whole life... No, this can't be true. You must be lying to me!
say:2:1410546001:1.source_cn: 我不相信，我无法接受……你们在骗我，尤其是你，你一直在——
say:2:1410546001:1.male: This is unbelievable. I can't believe that I've been living a lie my whole life... No, this can't be true. You must be lying to me!
say:2:1410546001:1.female: This is unbelievable. I can't believe that I've been living a lie my whole life... No, this can't be true. You must be lying to me!

say:3:1410546002:1.text: You've sensed that magic, even heard the calls and roars. Facts speak louder than emotions or words, young one.
say:3:1410546002:1.source_cn: 你曾经感受过那种魔力，甚至听到过呼唤与怒吼。事实的证据...

say:4:1410546003:1.text: Dwarves are obsessed with ores, so they take the egg shells and toss aside the essence, but... you're the opposite.
say:4:1410546003:1.source_cn: 矮人热爱矿物，所以渴求蛋壳，而将蛋清弃于一旁，你们则正...

say:5:1410546004:1.text: Your queen's hidden the truth about dragon egg essence and disguised it as the Divine Dew...
say:5:1410546004:1.source_cn: 你们的女王，她隐瞒着龙蛋清的真相，将它冠以恩典的名头——

say:6:1410546005:1.text: You can't speak about Her Majesty like that! She has always shared her life force with us! She's selfless and noble!
say:6:1410546005:1.source_cn: 不！女王赐予我们的就是恩典！女王一直与我们分享着她自己...

say:7:1410546006:1.text: Her grace warms us deep underground; she's the light of Sal'thorin!
say:7:1410546006:1.source_cn: 这份仁慈在幽暗的地底温暖着我们！她是照耀着萨洛克兰的光！

say:8:1410546007:1.text: Hello? Has the truth frightened you? Look above! The true warmth and light is right there above you at this very moment!
say:8:1410546007:1.source_cn: 醒醒吧！真正的温暖，真正的光明，此时此刻，不就挂在你的...

say:10:1410546009:1.text: I admit, the surface is beautiful, and it's nothing like I imagined...
say:10:1410546009:1.source_cn: ……我承认，地面很美丽……和我所知道的不一样。

say:11:1410546010:1.text: There are so many things I've never seen before—the bright sun, the rich soil, the beautiful plants, and the endless ocean...
say:11:1410546010:1.source_cn: 灿烂的阳光，清香的土壤，可爱的植物，还有一望无际的大海……

say:12:1410546011:1.text: Think! Are you going to believe what your eyes see or what your ears hear?
say:12:1410546011:1.source_cn: 仔细想想吧！你究竟是要相信自己的双眼，还是相信自己的耳朵！

say:13:1410546012:1.text: Okay... maybe you're right. Maybe the Divine Dew really is dragon egg essence... but...
say:13:1410546012:1.source_cn: 好吧……或许你们是对的！或许那就是龙蛋和蛋清！但是……但是！

say:14:1410546013:1.text: I still believe Her Majesty has her reasons for hiding everything. There must be a deeper purpose behind it!
say:14:1410546013:1.source_cn: 但我认为女王陛下选择隐瞒这一切，必然事出有因！她一定有...

say:15:1410546014:1.text: As a priest, I must not ignore Her Majesty's struggles!
say:15:1410546014:1.source_cn: 身为祭司，我不应该对女王的烦忧视若无睹！

say:16:1410546015:1.text: I should return to Sal'thorin and speak to the High Priestess. She may know something...
say:16:1410546015:1.source_cn: 我要回到萨洛克兰，找奎茵冕下询问真相！她也许知道些什么……

say:17:1410546016:1.text: *Sigh* You're as stubborn as a rock.
say:17:1410546016:1.source_cn: 唉……你的脑袋比锤头还铁，不撞疼，你是不会清醒过来的。

say:18:1410546017:1.text: Fine, if it helps you come to your senses, I'll come with you.
say:18:1410546017:1.source_cn: 好吧，如果这能帮助你认清现实，我愿意再陪你折腾一次。

say:19:1410546018:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what about you? Don't you want to see this through?
say:19:1410546018:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what about you? Don't you want to see this through?
say:19:1410546018:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what about you? Don't you want to see this through?

say:23:1410546022:0.text: Wait! Before we go back, I want to leave a mark here to celebrate my first time coming to the surface!
say:23:1410546022:0.source_cn: 等等，回去之前，我想要留下一些来过这里的痕迹！

choice_prompt:24:1410546022.text: Wait! Before we go back, I want to leave a mark here to celebrate my first time coming to the surface!
choice_prompt:24:1410546022.source_cn: 等等，回去之前，我想要留下一些来过这里的痕迹！

say:25:1410546023:1.text: Oh! Do you remember the flowers I grew when we first met? I followed a book to grow them. I think I could try planting some on the surface too!
say:25:1410546023:1.source_cn: 你还记得哇！那是我按照书上的记载，培育出的地表上的花。
say:25:1410546023:1.male: Oh! Do you remember the flowers I grew when we first met? I followed a book to grow them. I think I could try planting some on the surface too!
say:25:1410546023:1.female: Oh! Do you remember the flowers I grew when we first met? I followed a book to grow them. I think I could try planting some on the surface too!

say:27:1410546025:1.text: Heh, me too! And I happen to have some seeds with me!
say:27:1410546025:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，我还以为你突然夸我。不过这真是个好主意，花种我一...
say:27:1410546025:1.male: Heh, me too! And I happen to have some seeds with me!
say:27:1410546025:1.female: Heh, me too! And I happen to have some seeds with me!

say:28:1410546026:1.text: Let's go find a good place to plant them!
say:28:1410546026:1.source_cn: 走吧，我们去找个合适的地方种下它！
say:28:1410546026:1.male: Let's go find a good place to plant them!
say:28:1410546026:1.female: Let's go find a good place to plant them!

choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 我还记初见时你培育的那些花

say:30:1410546020:1.text: Sure, then come with us so you can see the truth with your own eyes.
say:30:1410546020:1.source_cn: 那太好了，你越是不相信我，我越要你亲眼见证真相！
say:30:1410546020:1.male: Sure, then come with us so you can see the truth with your own eyes.
say:30:1410546020:1.female: Sure, then come with us so you can see the truth with your own eyes.
